{{Top|leg}}
The '''zolall''' was a nocturnal predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. It was a hairless smooth-skinned creature with a long tail and triangular wings. Air sacs in the abdomen kept it aloft. It was a vicious predator that ensnared prey in its tail. Poison sacs under the zolall's tongue produced a [[Zolall venom/Legends|venom]] that the [[Loag]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] used to coat their blades.
